title: Free Falling
subtitle: The poet said: Lift your head and gaze upon the eternal dome—

trails.title: Off Stage
trails.description: We need volunteers to explore the unknown.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Oh, I nearly forgot to introduce myself. My name is APPLe. I owe you my thanks, sir ...

items.speaker: Ezio
items.text: Ezio Auditore. But just Ezio is fine.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Of course, Ezio. This APPLe is something of a ... visitor from far away.
Ezio nods.

items.speaker: Ezio
items.text: Is that so? You know, you haven't gone unnoticed, I heard word of you from my allies many months ago. They've been tracking you for some time.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: I was being followed? Blimey.

items.speaker: Ezio
items.text: We might have never even known you were anything but an ordinary fruit—if you hadn't started talking in your sleep.

items.speaker: Ezio
items.text: Leonardo has told you what's going on, yes? Is there anything you don't understand?

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Anything? Everything! These Templars, the Compliners, the frescoes ... And you for that matter!
The wind seems to carry his voice far further than it should.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: I know your friend was only stalling for time ... but he all but scared the life out of me when he came at me with that scalpel.

items.speaker: Ezio
items.text: There are many things that need explaining; for now, you need only know that these men are Templars, ancient enemies of the Assassins.

items.speaker: Ezio
items.text: The war between us has lasted a long, long time ... I fear it will never end.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: I see ... Isn't there a more peaceful way to solve this? Too often violence only treats the symptoms while letting the disease grow.

items.speaker: Ezio
items.text: I wish there was, but no. Too many have died to the ambition of the Templars. Even my own ...
Ezio pauses, hanging on the next word.

items.speaker: Ezio
items.text: Still, there is wisdom in what you say. Violence has a habit of making things worse.

items.speaker: Ezio
items.text: But there is a chance now to end this; to destroy them once and for all. So that no one else must suffer.
Ezio puts his right hand on his chest and bows to APPLe.

items.speaker: Ezio
items.text: I'm sorry we dragged you into this, Mr. APPLe.

items.speaker: Ezio
items.text: But we must not let the Templars get the relics, so ... we need to know where you stand.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: You and Leonardo seem to be close.
The statement confuses Ezio, who eyes APPLe looking for some glimmer of intent. Until, at last, he nods.

items.speaker: Ezio
items.text: Yes. We've known each other for a long time.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Great. Then you have my full trust.

items.speaker: Ezio
items.text: Huh ...?
APPLe clears his throat.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: I am certain that Leonardo is a good person ... if the history books—erhm, I mean, my intuition is anything to go by.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: So, I believe that one of his close friends must also be trustworthy.

items.speaker: Ezio
items.text: Oh?
The Assassin smiles.

items.speaker: Ezio
items.text: Good to see my charm hasn't dulled. Thanks for your trust.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Before we go, please allow this APPLe to make a request.

items.speaker: Ezio
items.text: Anything, friend. I am at your service.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: When I first came to Florence, I was supposed to be with some friends ... but we were separated.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Would you help me find them? And keep them safe, if need be.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Given the circumstances, I worry this city may become quite dangerous for them.

items.speaker: Ezio
items.text: No problem.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Then I must repay your "thanks," sir.

items.speaker: Ezio
items.text: If we succeed here, then there is nothing I could do that will ever compare to what the world will owe you.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: This APPLe is only too happy to help.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: I'm certain the Captain would be jealous if she found out I were so sought after, but this APPLe enjoys a little attention too sometimes.

items.speaker: Ezio
items.text: Everyone has their moment in the sun. When the time comes, even the least of us can change the course of history.
He holds out his hand.

items.speaker: Ezio
items.text: So, then we are agreed? We join forces?
The evening glow witnesses an agreement between an apple and an assassin.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Naturally!

items.speaker: Ezio
items.text: Leonardo will be waiting for us at his workshop. Are you ready?

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Ready for what, our visit? Oh, by jove. Perhaps I should prepare a gift first ...
Ezio walks to the edge of the scaffolding with purpose.
He crouches, looking down at the busy street beneath their perch. In that moment he looks almost like an eagle searching for prey.

items.speaker: Ezio
items.text: Now, are you ready to jump?

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: From here? ... Down there?

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: This APPLe can fly, of course, but from this height ... I doubt you would survive. I suggest we find another way.

items.speaker: Ezio
items.text: Why waste time?
The wind blows past their ears.
The assassin grabs the golden apple and leaps into the air with all the confidence of an eagle taking flight.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: What?!

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Noooo!!
*thud*

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: *cough*
The air reeks of straw and soil.
They land with precision in a cart full of hay.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: This APPLe may have experienced some anoxia during our fall. I'm so dizzy ...

items.speaker: Ezio
items.text: Shh ...

items.speaker: Ezio
items.text: Quiet. Don't give our hiding spot away.
Night has fallen. The man and the fruit hidden in the hay can hear the sound of marching footsteps.

items.speaker: Templar Commander
items.text: O, you! You with the blue hat!
The street falls silent after that. All the people around the lady with the blue hat, including the two hiding in the hay, wait on her reply.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Good evening ... gentlemen. Is there something wrong?

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: What?!

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: That voice! Hah, I have a good feeling about this.
The encounter just beyond their hay-strewn lair continues.

items.speaker: Templar Commander
items.text: I have never seen someone dressed like you before; where are you from? What are you doing in Firenze?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I'm a visitor to Florence. Here's my identification ...
The soldier waves his hand impatiently.

items.speaker: Templar Commander
items.text: It doesn't matter. Tell me, have you seen a man in a gray hood pass by?
She glances over to the corner of the street.
Not far from view a pile of hay lies gently rustling in the night air, looking entirely and inescapably ordinary.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Not that I know of.

items.speaker: Templar III
items.text: Then have you seen something ... eh, something golden ...
The soldier draws something like a circle in the air clumsily.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: ... Hmm?

items.speaker: Templar Commander
items.text: Come on. She's useless.

items.speaker: Templar Commander
items.text: Keep moving.
The clang of metal echoes around then fades away as the lively sounds of night return.
After a while, a voice rings out softly from just outside their hiding spot.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: You alright in there?
The voice hints at an unexpected reunion.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Vertin! Oh, this APPLe is ever so glad to see you again, if only I didn't look a right mess ... Please give me a minute.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: With all the talk about a "golden apple" I had a feeling I would find you here.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Looks like luck's in my favor this time.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: But how did you get in here? Did you jump from that tower?

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Erhm, it's a long story.

items.speaker: Ezio
items.text: Good evening, miss. You have my thanks for your assistance.

items.speaker: Ezio
items.text: Is she one of the friends you talked about, APPLe?

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: That's right! This is Vertin, a most trustworthy friend and companion!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I appreciate the compliment, Mr. APPLe. And who is this gentleman?

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: This is Ezio Auditore, an assassin!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: An assassin? Really?

items.speaker: Ezio
items.text: Please, don't let the reputation of our name confuse you. We assassins kill only when there is a just cause.

items.speaker: Ezio
items.text: But maybe I can explain later. The curfew will begin soon, and I'd like to avoid any further complications with the guards.

items.speaker: Ezio
items.text: My friend must be worried about us already.
